text:
## Policy Review & Updates  
**Review Frequency:** Annual (or on GDPR change)
**Last Review:** 2026-01-15
**Next Review:** 2027-01-15  
---
name: Chunk 34/36

raw_entities.name: Policy Review and Updates Framework
raw_entities.description: A policy framework governing the periodic review and update cycle for banking policies, with mandatory annual review frequency or upon GDPR regulatory changes. This framework establishes the cadence and triggers for policy maintenance and ensures compliance documentation remains current.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or on GDPR change)

raw_entities.name: Annual Policy Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that policies be reviewed on an annual basis, or more frequently if triggered by changes to GDPR or other regulatory requirements. This provision ensures policies remain aligned with current regulatory obligations.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or on GDPR change)

raw_entities.name: GDPR Change Trigger for Policy Review
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring an immediate policy review and update whenever GDPR or related data protection regulations change, outside the standard annual review cycle. This ensures the bank maintains compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or on GDPR change)

raw_entities.name: General Data Protection Regulation
raw_entities.description: European Union data protection regulation that triggers policy review and update obligations when substantive changes occur. The policy explicitly references GDPR as a regulatory driver for out-of-cycle policy maintenance.
